verdict.rationale: ClickHouse can clearly run headlessly. clickhouse-local runs SQL straight from the command line without a server. The clickhousectl CLI installs versions, launches local servers, executes queries and manages Cloud resources, and installs as a one-line single binary. Community users report standing up clusters from official Docker images, and the HTTP interface lets responses be scripted programmatically. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), documented non-interactive/token auth for Cloud automation, and independent hands-on reports of CI usage specifically.
